definitions: The intrinsic nature or indispensable quality of something, especially something abstract, that determines its character.
A property or group of properties of a thing without which it would not exist or be what it is.
A preparation, typically a liquid, containing the concentrated flavour or aroma of an ingredient used in food or perfume.
A philosophical term referring to the fundamental being or reality of a thing.
examples: The artist tried to capture the essences of the landscape.
These perfumes are made from rare flower essences.
Philosophers debate the essences of human nature.
The chef used fruit essences to enhance the dessert.
